layout: row-major; row 0 is the northern edge (maxY), column 0 the western edge (minX); value i*cols+j is the cell centre at east = minX + (j+0.5)*cell_size, north = maxY - (i+0.5)*cell_size
crs: local ENU metres from the habitat (habitat_01 = 0,0) at lat 18.452739, lon 77.405768 (planetocentric, east positive, Mars 2000 sphere R=3396190 m). Same frame as outputs JSON files.
minerals_encoding: 0 = not detected, 1 = medium confidence, 2 = high confidence (probable detections)
resampling: bilinear from the team 5 m grid (elevation, slope, roughness), nearest for thermal inertia and minerals; slope reference 20.0 deg is a warning, not a mask

sources.elevation: USGS Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE DTM (1 m)
sources.minerals: CRISM mineral map, Parente, Itoh & Saranathan, Zenodo 5575824

note: For drawing and for the import page only. Routes, times and effort come from routes.json and emergency.json; do not recompute them in the browser.
